answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to seek an incumbent renewal that meets the 18% mandate while preserving the proven stable integration and scheduled-delivery performance. The low-cost vendor's prior quick onboarding and accurate invoicing do not establish delivery reliability under a 94%-loaded line with no buffer. Verify the prior renegotiation record to assess whether the incumbent has historically moved enough on price and terms; if not, preserve a short, controlled transition path rather than assume a primary switch is risk-free.
